question: When it rains heavily, my terrace leaks into the flat below. Where do I start?

httpResponse.answer: Check drainage, junctions, and lateral water pressure to identify the source of the leak [S1]. Confirm the source of water ingress, drainage, gradients, and junctions with parapets, doors, and downpipes [S2].
